fact: 1904年4月8日法英签署协约国协定（Entente Cordiale）：法国承诺不阻挠英国在埃及的行动，英国允许法国在摩洛哥“维持秩序并提供协助”；协定终结了法英在殖民地的长期对抗，法国由此走出孤立。

sources.title: Wikipedia — Entente Cordiale
sources.quote: The Entente Cordiale ... comprised a series of agreements signed on 8 April 1904 between the United Kingdom and France which saw a significant improvement in Anglo-French relations. / The Entente was composed of three documents: The first and most important document was the Declaration respecting Egypt and Morocco. In return for the French promising not to "obstruct" British actions in Egypt, the British promised to allow the French to "preserve order ... and provide assistance" in Morocco.

fact: 协约国协定中法国的具体所得与让步：获得英国认可的摩洛哥势力范围、在暹罗湄南河以东的势力范围；让出纽芬兰西岸权利（保留捕鱼权）并放弃对埃及事务的反对——法国外长德尔卡塞主导的外交重组。

sources.title: Wikipedia — Entente Cordiale
sources.quote: The second document dealt with Newfoundland and portions of West and Central Africa. The French gave up their rights (stemming from the Treaty of Utrecht) over the western coast of Newfoundland, known as the French Shore, although they retained the right to fish the coast. / In Siam, the British recognised a proposed French sphere of influence to the east of the Menam (Chao Phraya) River basin; in turn, the French recognised a proposed British influence over the territory to the west of the Menam basin.

fact: 法国银行团在日俄战争期间向俄国提供总计8亿法郎（3,040万英镑）贷款（另有6亿法郎谈妥后取消）；对俄贷款是在法俄同盟与经济利益捆绑下、经法国报界公关后完成的——巴黎资本市场是帝俄的战争银行。

sources.title: Wikipedia — Russo-Japanese War（Economics节）
sources.quote: Despite its gold reserves of 106.3 million pounds, Russia's pre-war financial situation was not enviable. ... Russia's war effort was funded primarily by France, in a series of loans totalling 800 million francs (£30.4 million); another loan in the amount of 600 million francs was agreed upon, but later cancelled. ... In addition to French money, Russia secured a loan in the amount of 500 million marks (£24.5 million) from Germany, who also financed Japan's war effort.

fact: 巴黎证券交易所只有70名法定经纪人（Agents de Change），由共和国总统法令任命、必须是年满25岁享有完全民事与政治权利的法国公民；他们对政府证券及其他挂牌证券的交易享有绝对垄断——在法国买卖挂牌证券必须经过这70人。

sources.title: The Stock Exchange from Within, chapter X
sources.quote: The Bourse in Paris differs from all others in that its membership consists of but seventy. These Agents de Change, as they are called, enjoy an absolute monopoly not only to trade in government and other officially listed securities, but also to negotiate bills of exchange and similar instruments of credit.

fact: 1900年巴黎普通壮工平均日工资约5法郎、一公斤面包0.50法郎（一日工资约可买40条长棍面包的等值面包）；该比较数据是1900年代初巴黎生活成本的行业汇编基线。

fact: 1893年法律要求所有外国人（包括从业的外国未成年人）在抵达后八日内向市政府与警察机关申报居留；在巴黎须向警察总署办理并取得从事职业所需的登记证书——1904年在法外国人的居留合规是八日申报制。

sources.title: Enregistrer et identifier les étrangers en France, 1880-1940
sources.quote: tous les étrangers – hommes, femmes ainsi que les mineurs exerçant un travail – doivent désormais faire une demande de déclaration de résidence, dans les huit jours suivant leur arrivée, dans leur mairie et auprès de la préfecture du Rhône à Lyon et de la préfecture de police à Paris. En théorie, les étrangers voyageant pour leur agrément ou leur santé sont soumis à la seule déclaration prévue par le décret de 1888 et les étrangers exerçant une profession, un commerce ou une industrie à celle prévue par la loi de 1893. En échange, chaque demandeur reçoit un certificat d’immatriculation qui est obligatoire pour exercer un métier.

fact: 1900年法国全国汽车不足3,000辆，米其林兄弟同年出版首版指南并免费发放35,000册以推动汽车旅行；至1900年代汽车与相关服务仍是极小众但被资本看好的新产业——法国是早期汽车与轮胎工业的中心之一。

sources.title: The History of the Michelin Guide
sources.quote: It was a time when driving was perceived as a novelty to most, with less than 3,000 cars in all of the country. In 1900, the very first edition of the Michelin Guide was published and 35,000 copies were given out for free.
